beats: Hook: a program written for an ion trap lands on a superconducting chip that cannot run its two-qubit gate (line_qc_cook_odd_card: the cook takes only three card shapes; the head waiter brings a fourth). Can it run at all, and what does the translation cost? Cast: the head waiter (the compiler), the cook (the chip: does only what is native), the technician (the hardware side, from QC02-01).
Infinitely many gates in principle, few natively (36:15-37:11).

Calibration (37:26-38:50, clip 37:26-37:54): each native gate is a pulse whose shape and size must be tuned, and the tuning drifts, so machines go offline for hours to retune (line_qc_piano_tuner; her hours as typical, not exact). Continuous rotations would each need their own tuning (Q24-04 58:08-59:31; reuse line_knob_board).

Native sets differ by technology (p16 redrawn as lettering, credit Murali et al.; MS/XX on ions, cross-resonance on IBM chips, another set on Rigetti chips; 39:38-41:36); software-visible gates are a bigger set: the same toy house built from three different kits (line_qc_three_kits).

Gate synthesis (p17, 41:52-43:15): the compiler rewrites any gate into the native ones; one MS gate becomes seven gates on a CNOT-only chip (the count drawn on p17: check) (line_qc_one_into_seven). SWAP = three CNOTs as a matrix product (p18, 43:39-45:05: code on the taped slide).

Universality (45:31-46:22, clip 45:56-46:22; her answer 52:00-52:59): single-qubit gates plus one entangling gate can run any program ({H, T, CNOT}, Nielsen & Chuang 4.5): the three card shapes can spell every order (the cover shows it).
The trade-off (57:26-58:59, clip 58:25-58:59): more native gates mean shorter programs but more to calibrate (line_qc_tune_few_or_many).

What makes a good gate set (Q24-04 59:39-61:24): Z as four T gates vs one native Z; like the matrix units in ML accelerators (reuse line_gpu); a co-design loop between hardware and algorithm people, like reduced and complex instruction sets (Q24-05 33:43-35:34, clip 34:36-35:34) (line_qc_codesign_pingpong). Q24-04 and Q24-05 have student voices: her lines only.
Cover (line_qc_cover_qc02_03; for the X post and thumbnails, not a film beat): the head waiter hands the cook seven small cards in the three known shapes in place of the one odd card.
